title: Arsenal Snags Star Defender Ezri Konsa for a Whopping £51 Million!
summary:
Have you ever played a video game where you trade players to make your team stronger? That's kind of what Arsenal just did in real life! The Premier League champions signed England defender Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa for a huge amount of money—£51 million, which is about $69 million. That's enough to buy a lot of pizza!

Konsa is 28 years old and played for England at the World Cup this year. He's known for being really good at defending, and he can play in the middle or on the right side. Arsenal's manager, Mikel Arteta, needed a new defender because William Saliba is hurt and will be out for months. Konsa will team up with Gabriel Magalhaes to protect the goal.

Konsa is super excited. He said, "It's a privilege to be here and I can't wait to get started. I want to keep winning, I'm hungry to win and that's what I'm here for." He also said it's a proud moment for his family to play for one of the best teams in the world.

Arsenal won the Premier League last season for the first time in 22 years, and they want to do it again. Konsa might even play his first game against his old team, Aston Villa, on August 31. That would be a little awkward, but also exciting!

Konsa said his England teammates like Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka told him how great Arsenal is, and that helped him decide to join. He also won the Europa League last season, and now he wants to win even more trophies. Arsenal fans are hoping he can help them stay on top!
why_it_matters: This story is like a real-life version of building a sports team in a video game: one important change can make a whole group stronger, but it also costs a huge amount of money.

background_read: In soccer, clubs buy and sell players through transfers; a transfer fee is the money a new club pays to the player's old club.
Arsenal is a famous soccer club from London, and Aston Villa is a club from Birmingham, England; both play in the Premier League, the top soccer league in England.
The Europa League is Europe's second-biggest club tournament, after the Champions League, and winning it is a major honor.
Article_Structure: WHO: Arsenal, new defender Ezri Konsa, manager Mikel Arteta, and injured defender William Saliba.
WHAT: Arsenal signed Konsa from Aston Villa for £51 million, about $69 million, to strengthen their defense.
WHERE: In the Premier League in England; his first game may be against his old club Aston Villa on August 31.
WHY: Arsenal want to repeat as Premier League champions, and Konsa wants to keep winning trophies after his Europa League win.
